text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer is here, and with the Kikuka Sho approaching, we have our work cut out for us. As the bus sets off for summer camp, we seem to be travelling in an auspicious direction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru delights in her good fortune—until the bus overshoots good fortune and heads toward misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Expecting all sorts of hardships at camp, Matikanefukukitaru falls into despair.
